initial_application: Git history shows the issue was initially applied in d7dbd7689b by commenting the core ResearchStudy.relatesTo backbone out of source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-ResearchStudy.xml and adding source/researchstudy/structuredefinition-extension-researchStudy-relatesTo.xml. The extension had targetClassifier 0..* and target 1..1, while partOf and relatedArtifact remained on ResearchStudy.
additional_context: FHIR-32315 later removed the ResearchStudy relatesTo extension after RelatedArtifact changes met the original need. FHIR-49760 later removed ResearchStudy.relatedArtifact and deliberately added ResearchStudy.relatesTo back as a core R6 element with target[x] 1..1. FHIR-50459 and FHIR-53003 then refined the current R6 element with the DocumentReference comment and CodeableConcept/extensible relatesTo.type.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped ResearchStudy source already reflects the later issue family: ResearchStudy.partOf remains, ResearchStudy.relatedArtifact is absent by the later R6 decision, ResearchStudy.relatesTo is active as a core element, and ResearchStudy.relatesTo.target[x] is 1..1.
